a: £38,448–£46,970; 2 years in the first instance, possible extension
dt: Closing date 15 December 2026 (ref LE51646); separate from the MicroBH AJO expression of interest
e: This postdoc is in Jorge Santos's group, part of the John Templeton Foundation MicroBH network (with IPhT, Sapienza and UIUC), working on black-hole microstate geometries, numerical relativity and GW signatures, starting Aug/Sep 2027. It is open to PhDs in physics or related fields, and the hire must be eligible to live and work in the UK.
